dominant_strengths: Confident wide-tracked wordmark and headline pairing establishes a strong, technical brand voice with clear hierarchy
Restrained dark palette with a single amber CTA creates focused attention on primary action without visual noise
Category tile grid below fold suggests structured navigation through use cases, hinting at systematic IA
dominant_weaknesses: For an 'interactive experience engine,' the hero is static and shows zero motion proof — a missed credibility moment
Empty black tiles labeled only by category read as placeholder skeletons rather than curated showcase, weakening trust
Vertical rhythm is loose: huge whitespace above wordmark, then abrupt jump to dense gallery row at viewport edge
fix_priorities: Replace static hero with live Rive animation demonstrating the engine — non-negotiable for a motion tool
Populate showcase tiles with actual artwork thumbnails or looping previews to convert promise into evidence
Tighten hero spacing and let category strip overlap viewport intentionally rather than crop awkwardly
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leans on typographic gravitas but underdelivers without motion; behavioral is clear but generic; reflective fails to convey what makes Rive different from Lottie or Figma.
rationale.intent_fit: Communicates 'serious motion tool' through type and palette but ironically fails to demonstrate interactivity, undercutting the core brief.
